channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Sempra quarterly and annual earnings fall, but beat estimates and stock rises
item.description: The quarterly results were better than expected on Wall Street and Sempra stock rose 2.2% in early trading.

item.title: The Flower Fields are back with 80 million blooms blanketing 55 acres
item.description: This coming week brings all of San Diego's signs of spring with the opening of The Flower Fields at Carlsbad Ranch.

item.title: Elo-Rivera’s second home tax advances to full council hearing
item.description: A City Council committee unanimously approved a proposal to tax empty second homes from Councilmember Sean Elo-Rivera Wednesday. It now goes to a full Council vote on March 3 and aims for the June ballot.

item.title: ‘Tonight isn’t about bullets and targets. It’s about boundaries’: Escondido residents denounce ICE contract
item.description: The Escondido City Council has refused to cancel a contract to share its police firing range with Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: Six shows (and some rooftop movies) to see in San Diego this weekend
item.description: Theater season is in full swing in San Diego, so here are six more shows for your consideration.

item.title: ‘You can’t even face us, can you?’ – Point Loma mother asks killer son in court
item.description: William "Billy" Bushey, 61, shot June Bushey almost two years ago. She survived the attack, but her daughter and grandson did not.

item.title: Del Norte High alum Ferree has fairy-tale start to SDFC career in front of hometown fans
item.description: Facing four shots – only two were on target – goalkeeper Duran Furree was a big part of SDFC's 5-0 dismantling of CF Montréal.

item.title: Investigation of 2025 assault ends with 10 arrests, including 9 Navy sailors
item.description: The joint law enforcement operation resulted in arrests at five locations, including Naval Air Station North Island and Naval Base San Diego.

item.title: Return to free Balboa Park parking about to begin, but only in select lots for verified city residents
item.description: The move, promised by Mayor Gloria almost three weeks ago, followed loud objections to new parking fees at the popular attraction.

item.title: Rain went away, now it’s hot as heck – it’ll be a sunny, hot February weekend in San Diego
item.description: Friday is expected to be the warmest day this week and forecasters say the sunny day brings the potential for several top temperature records.
